name: Krshak Prashikshan Tatha Bhraman Karyakram
benefit:
1. Farmer training within the state : ₹1,000/- per farmer per month (maximum 7 days)
1. Farmer training outside the state : ₹1,500/- per farmer per day.
1. Exposure visit outside the state to observe new technology (new component) : ₹1,500/- per farmer per day.
1. A total of ₹12,000/- for 20 trainees in one-day farmer training and tour, i.e. maximum expenditure per farmer is ₹500/- and honorarium
_eligibility_text:
1. This scheme will apply to all sections.
1. Farmers of all classes who cultivate crops.
